evidence: Every workflow page links its locale download sibling and vice versa.
Visible breadcrumb navigation gives crawlers a consistent home-to-section path.
All eight special pages carry server-rendered BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.
Each breadcrumb uses absolute canonical URLs and ordered ListItem positions.
Breadcrumb labels match English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese page language.
The navigation is exposed to assistive technology with an aria-label.

conditions: Validator must require sibling links and BreadcrumbList on all eight pages.
Browser smoke must verify visible breadcrumbs and sibling hrefs.
Live routes must return HTTP 200 after deployment.
